title: An appealing version meets fair foundations

captions.physics: Repeating an appealing account of results
captions.energy: Honestly comparing a shared version’s foundations

meaning: Honest comparison of foundations can support examining an appealing version and respect for a value that becomes understandable within it.
text: An appealing version can rest on a value worth naming separately. The Devil in the physical position of Ajna shows repeating a pleasing explanation of results. Justice in energy honestly compares a shared version’s foundations. The Hierophant in emotions feels respect for understood meaning. You can enjoy a familiar cause and want to see which valuable relationship it preserves beyond questions of its completeness or accuracy for both people.

For example, you explain a successful shared undertaking through mutual trust alone and repeat one striking scene. **Honest comparison can separate valuable foundations from an appealing version’s completeness.** You notice trust alongside tasks divided beforehand. Each foundation gains its own place. Respect for trust remains when it need not explain every detail of the result. Your view sees a relationship’s value alongside work’s actual structure. A favourite account permits revision without becoming empty or making one scene evidence of everything that happened during your shared undertaking.

The risk is treating respect for a value as sufficient confirmation of any associated version. Honest comparison preserves differences between significance and explanation. Your view develops when foundations can be considered separately. A familiar account’s appeal then remains understandable, while discovered meaning retains worth without excluding other details from a shared picture or requiring an identical conclusion from each person.
